question: What is the chance of a crash if I have more than two custom mysteries in the game 'WORLD OF HORROR'?

candidates.title: 0.9.84 ‘THE CEASELESS CURSE’
candidates.text:
Major features for this patch include:

- This content update focuses on the unfortunate people of SHIOKAWA and the city's dark secrets.
- The newly reworked CITY PLANNING feature will allow players to customize their game and select new additional actions.
- Two new characters: a truly cursed WITCH and the EX-CULTIST on the run join the character roster, bringing it to eleven playable heroes, each with unique perks and abilities.
- This upgrade introduces character-exclusive events exploring their backstories and their role in the story. This is the biggest batch of new events since the initial release.
- Additionally, two new mysteries will have the unsuspecting characters take care of a weird friend with a dark secret and explore the seemingly abandoned mansion full of grotesque paintings.
- A new game mode CHALLENGES will test the skills of experienced players, placing them in the pre-selected playthroughs, each having unique gameplay mechanics, forcing them to change their strategies.

If you find any issues, bugs, or typos in the game, as always please report them to our official bug tracking sheet.

Due to the game-breaking issues caught on Mac at the last second, the macOS version will be published as soon as things are resolved.

Thanks for reading!

question: What are some specific issues the player has with the game's passing mechanics?

candidates.title: Infinite Lagrange review
candidates.text: Lets get something out of the way right now, Yes it has pay to win mechanics. Yes there are whales who can own servers when teamed together. But do not let this convince you that you can not take out whales, With good server diplomacy and overwhelming numbers/participants any whale union can be felled. Overall this games has a very well blended amount of features, Customization options, ability to roam fairly freely, pve, pvp and a thriving community. It operates in phases, with each lasting a month or so, with a week break inbetween phases. The first few phases tend to be the most balanced as most players even whales will be playing on near level fields/fleets. After a few seasons the pay to win mechanics tend to bring themselves forward more.I give it to the devs and creative team, They have added much more story and lore giving what once felt barebones, some much needed meat on those bones! The PC version runs well, make sure to check one of the guides if you are a returning player(Bind your steam account on whatever you played with first, before attempting to doanload steam version and playing.) It does have some navigation issues and qwerks but they have tried to alleviate the pathing issues. Overall I recommend if you enjoy these style of games.
